name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B (Prism ML, ternary derivative of Qwen3.8-27B)

official_org.value: Prism ML, Inc. (Pasadena, Caltech spin-out). The HF org prism-ml publishes the whole Bonsai line (50+ repos). NOTICE.txt: 'copyright 2026-present Prism ML, Inc.'. Many community derivatives (abliterated / heretic / MTP repacks) exist but are not vendor files.

release_date.value: HF createdAt 2026-09-16T23:40:56Z, first commit 'Bonsai2' 2026-09-17; press release dated 2026-09-17 (datePublished 2026-09-17). Q2_0 file for stock llama.cpp added 2026-10-30; lastModified 2026-11-04.

license.value: Apache-2.0 (cardData license apache-2.0; LICENSE file is Apache 2.0). No use restrictions. NOTICE asks (not requires) attribution 'Created using Bonsai by Prism ML' and carries the Qwen3.8-27B Apache-2.0 notice (Alibaba Cloud).

params.value: Dense, 27.36B total = 24.35B language backbone (64 blocks) + 2.54B embedding/LM head + 0.46B vision tower (card). Active = total (dense). Press release says 27.8B; base Qwen3.8-27B safetensors total is 27,781,427,952. Ternary {-1,0,+1} g128 with FP16 scales, true 1.72 bpw; 26.2M params (GDN recurrent path + norms) kept high precision.

architecture.value: Unchanged Qwen3.8-27B hybrid (GGUF arch 'qwen35'; MLX config model_type 'prism_hadamard_qwen35'): 64 layers, full_attention_interval 4 -> 16 full-attention layers (GQA 24 q heads, 4 KV heads, head_dim 256) + 48 Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers (16 key heads, 48 value heads, dim 128, conv kernel 4); hidden 5120, FFN 17408, vocab 248320, max_position_embeddings 262144. Weights stored in a blockwise-Hadamard-rotated basis (block 1024); runtime must apply the matching FWHT to activations (prism.hadamard.* GGUF keys). MLX config mtp_num_hidden_layers 0 (no MTP head in the vendor MLX build).

context_length.value: 262,144 tokens (GGUF context_length 262144; card '262K'). On this GPU with stock llama.cpp: about 128k with q8_0 KV comfortable, about 200k q8_0 maximum, about 96k-110k with f16 KV (see llamacpp).

modalities.value: Text + image input, text output. Vision tower ships separately as mmproj (Q8_0 0.586 GiB, BF16 0.867 GiB). Text-only path: load only the language GGUF and pass --no-mmproj (with -hf, llama-server otherwise auto-fetches the mmproj). The vendor MLX build has no vision.

thinking.how_to_toggle: Thinks by default at reasoning_effort 'xhigh'. Template (GGUF chat_template): enable_thinking false -> empty <think></think>; reasoning_effort accepts only xhigh|medium|low, anything else raises (so 'high' gives HTTP 500, known issue open); 'low' barely shortens thinking per vendor; vendor recommends 'medium' for agents with moderate output budgets. llama.cpp b12407: per request chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking":false} or top-level reasoning_effort:"none" (server-common.cpp maps 'none' to enable_thinking=false; other values pass into template kwargs); server default off with --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":false}'; keep --reasoning auto because --reasoning on overrides a client 'none' (known issue); thinking_budget in chat_template_kwargs is ignored, use --reasoning-budget N or a top-level budget field. Ollama: think:false/true on /api/chat (library lists 'thinking' capability). vLLM: not applicable (no supported checkpoint).

tool_calling.format:
Qwen3-Coder XML: <tool_call>
<function=NAME>
<parameter=ARG>
value
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>; tools rendered as JSON inside <tools> in the system block; tool results as <tool_response> in a user turn. llama.cpp b12407 common/chat.cpp detects this template as 'Qwen3-Coder' (needs <tool_call>, <function=, <parameter=) and uses common_chat_params_init_qwen3_coder.
tool_calling.evidence: Template has native tool rendering and the arguments|items loop. Vendor BFCL v3 74.92 vs 76.74 FP16 (thinking mode, self-reported). Vendor KNOWN_ISSUES (open): malformed or looping tool calls ('// // //') as a 'known model limitation in structured output'; HTTP 500/400 when a tool call has empty or non-JSON arguments (fork #112, open); HTTP 500 if a system message is not first or there are two; context growth and prompt-cache misses in tool loops because preserve_thinking defaults true and reasoning is re-rendered. Independent: InsiderLLM RTX 3090 routing split (thinking off, temp 0): Bonsai PQ2_0 12/47 exact vs Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL 19/47; tool field tied 28/28, valid JSON 47/47, scope field 18 vs 28. The Unsloth warning ('1-bit should not be used for agentic use-cases') concerns post-training IQ1-class quants; Bonsai is trained ternary (press release: 'trained using Google v5 TPUs'), so it does not transfer directly, but no independent agentic benchmark exists.

checkpoints.format: GGUF Q2_0 (ggml type 42), 2.25 bpw, Hadamard metadata; runs on STOCK llama.cpp >= b11556. 7,626,008,928 B = 7.10 GiB
GGUF PQ2_0 (Prism type, trit in 2-bit slot), 2.13 bpw; PrismML llama.cpp fork only. 7,206,168,928 B = 6.71 GiB
GGUF PTQ1_0 (Prism dense-trit type), 1.75 bpw; PrismML fork only. 5,946,648,928 B = 5.54 GiB
GGUF F16 (rotated ternary values in F16), stock llama.cpp >= b11556. 53,808,408,928 B = 50.11 GiB (does not fit)
GGUF mmproj vision tower Q8_0, 629,246,976 B = 0.586 GiB (BF16 variant 0.867 GiB)
MLX 2-bit affine g128 (Apple only), about 8.02 GiB total
Old location of the same Q2_0 file (Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-Q2_0-prism-fork-required.gguf, 7,626,008,928 B); README says moved to main repo

vllm.arch_supported: No. registry.py at v0.33.0 lists Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (line 617) but nothing Prism/Bonsai/Hadamard. No Bonsai 2 27B safetensors ('unpacked') or AWQ checkpoint is published (those exist only for the older Bonsai 27B). GGUF loading is an out-of-tree plugin not in the image, and Prism types plus the Hadamard activation transform are unsupported, so no vLLM path exists.
vllm.known_issues: Card says vendor benchmarks used 'EvalScope + vLLM on H100', implying an internal unpublished vLLM path.
vllm.kv_math: Shown for reference only: 2 x 16 full-attn layers x 4 KV heads x 256 x 2 B = 65,536 B/token BF16 (32,768 FP8). Not applicable: no loadable checkpoint.

llamacpp.arch_supported: Yes for the Q2_0 and F16 files in stock b12407: PR #29600 'model: support for Prism Bonsai 2 27B' merged 2026-10-11, released as b11556 (published 2026-10-11T13:31Z). At tag b12407: src/llama-arch.cpp has LLM_ARCH_QWEN35 'qwen35' (line 45) and prism.hadamard.* keys (lines 509-519); ggml.h has GGML_TYPE_Q2_0 = 42 and GGML_TYPE_COUNT 44 with no PQ2_0/PTQ1_0 types; ggml-cuda has Q2_0 in mmvq/mmq/convert/getrows and fwht.cu with a 1024-wide block kernel (the model's Hadamard block). PQ2_0 and PTQ1_0 are NOT in stock (vendor: 'Stock llama.cpp ... rejects them as unknown types'); they need the PrismML fork (latest release prism-b12128-d7b2896, 2026-10-31, prebuilt linux CUDA 12.4/12.8/13.3 tarballs, no Docker image found). Fork caveats: CUDA 13.3 binaries segfault on some Linux systems (#222 open); RTX 5090 sm_120 prebuilt Linux tarballs decode erratically (#199 open, fix = build with -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120a-real).
llamacpp.quant: Q2_0 (2.25 bpw ternary in a stock 2-bit type) for the stock image; PQ2_0 only if a self-built fork image is accepted
llamacpp.offload_plan: Everything on GPU (-ngl 99); dense model, no --n-cpu-moe. VRAM arithmetic: 16303 MiB = 15.92 GiB, minus 0.11 GiB idle. Weights 7.10 GiB. KV per token: 2 x 16 full-attn layers x 4 x 256 = 32,768 elements -> f16 65,536 B, q8_0 34,816 B. Gated DeltaNet state per sequence: 48 layers x 48 heads x 128 x 128 x 4 B = 144 MiB + conv state 48 x 3 x 10240 x 4 B = 5.6 MiB, about 0.15 GiB. Compute buffers about 1.0-1.3 GiB (248k-vocab logits at ubatch 512 alone is about 0.47 GiB). 131072 ctx q8_0 = 4.25 GiB -> total about 12.7 GiB (fits with about 3 GiB spare). 131072 f16 = 8.0 GiB -> about 16.5 GiB (does not fit). 262144 q8_0 = 8.5 GiB -> about 17.0 GiB (does not fit). Max: about 7.36 GiB free for KV -> q8_0 about 227k tokens, f16 about 120k tokens (theoretical; leave margin: q8_0 196608 or f16 98304). Context checkpoints and --cache-ram live in host RAM (about 40 GiB free).
llamacpp.server_command: docker run --rm --name bonsai2 --device nvidia.com/gpu=all -e GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 --memory 24g -p 127.0.0.1:8080:8080 -v $HOME/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda-b12407 -hf prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf --hf-file Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-Q2_0.gguf --no-mmproj --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 -ngl 99 -fa on -c 131072 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -np 1 --cache-ram 16384 --jinja --reasoning auto --chat-template-kwargs '{"reasoning_effort":"medium"}' --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --min-p 0.05 --presence-penalty 0.0 --repeat-penalty 1.0 -n 32768
llamacpp.tool_calling_note: Template routes to llama.cpp's Qwen3-Coder XML parser (same family as Qwen3.5/3.6, so baseline issues #30357 reasoning/whitespace not round-trippable and #30118 tool-call leak may apply). Vendor-open issues: malformed/looping tool calls, HTTP 500 on reasoning_effort 'high', HTTP 500 unless exactly one leading system message, HTTP 400/500 on empty tool arguments (send '{}'), prompt-cache misses in tool loops (do not echo reasoning back). Give large output budgets (-n 16384+) or thinking ends mid-trace with empty answers. --spec-type ngram-* has no effect (vendor). Verify OpenCode never sends reasoning_effort 'high' and sends a single system message.

sampling: Card: thinking temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20, min_p=0.05, presence_penalty=0.0, repetition_penalty=1.0; non-thinking temperature=0.7, top_p=0.80, top_k=20, min_p=0.0, presence_penalty=1.5, repetition_penalty=1.0. GGUF carries temp/top_p/top_k but not min_p or penalties (set them explicitly). Default reasoning effort xhigh; use medium for shorter traces; keep output limit >= 16384. Vendor: --repeat-penalty 1.05 did not help looping. Unsloth has no Bonsai page.
speed_notes: Inferred. Stock Q2_0 reads about 7.63 GB of weights per token: ceiling 896 / 7.63 = about 117 tok/s. Independent RTX 3090 (936 GB/s) PQ2_0 7.21 GB reached 77.6 tok/s, about 60% of its 130 tok/s ceiling, with trit-unpack overhead. Vendor says Blackwell batch-1 decode is instruction/launch bound and PQ2_0 is the faster Blackwell pack; stock Q2_0 kernel efficiency is unmeasured, the laptop runs at 140 W, and GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 costs some launch overhead. Estimate 45-75 tok/s decode at short context on this laptop, roughly 1.5-2x Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q3_K_XL. Prefill speculative: about 1000-2000 tok/s (3090 1476 pp512; 5090 3893). The FWHT activation transform adds per-matmul overhead in stock llama.cpp.

opencode_fit.recommended_runtime: llama.cpp stock image ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server-cuda-b12407 with the Q2_0 file (Ollama bonsai-2:27b as fallback)
opencode_fit.recommended_context: 131072 with q8_0 KV (about 12.7 GiB VRAM), or 98304 with f16 KV
opencode_fit.caveats: Strengths: fits fully on the 16 GB GPU at 128k context, Apache-2.0, dense Qwen3.8-27B backbone, roughly 2x faster decode than a Q4 27B. Risks: every agentic score (TB2.1 52.8, SWE-bench Verified 60.8, BFCL 74.92) is Prism-reported with 0 independent runs; the only independent quality test shows a clear field-level regression vs Qwen3.8-27B Q4 (12/47 vs 19/47). Vendor lists open malformed/looping tool calls and template HTTP 500s (reasoning_effort 'high', more than one or non-leading system message, empty tool args). Default xhigh thinking is long; set medium and large output limits. Stock image runs only Q2_0, not the vendor-preferred PQ2_0/PTQ1_0; the fork's sm_120 prebuilt binaries have an open erratic-decode issue. Treat as a speed/context alternative to pick #2 Qwen3.8-27B, to be ranked only after an on-machine tool-call smoke test and a short agentic task comparison.

gaps: No independent agentic or tool-calling benchmark (BenchLM 0 independent runs); TB2.1 / SWE-bench / tau2 numbers came via BenchLM from the whitepaper, which was not read directly (PDF at github.com/PrismML-Eng/Bonsai-demo/blob/main/bonsai-2-27b-whitepaper.pdf).
Stock-llama.cpp Q2_0 quality vs PQ2_0 is not stated; the Q2_0 file is newer (2026-10-30) and the vendor benchmarks were run with a vLLM path, not llama.cpp.
Stock Q2_0 + FWHT decode speed on sm_120 unmeasured; all speed numbers here are inferred.
Whether OpenCode v2.3.0 sends multiple or non-leading system messages, or reasoning_effort 'high', is unverified; either triggers HTTP 500 with this template.
Compute buffer size estimated (about 1-1.3 GiB), not measured.
Minimum Ollama version for Q2_0 + Hadamard not found; Ollama tag sizes are decimal GB from the library page.
